::: notes
Your turn to be placed. Open the percentile chunk in the browser lab – Workspace people too, this one lives in the lab and it is just a browser tab, no install – and give it your submitted result. It computes for you exactly the statistic I computed for the five analysts: the share of the whole grid that is more negative than your value. Two or three minutes. Then paste your percentile in chat, hold it, send on go. [go] Look at the range in the chat – the room spans a good stretch of the curve, and every one of you can now say precisely where you stand relative to eight hundred and forty defensible alternatives. That sentence – "my estimate sits at the Nth percentile of the specification space" – is a genuinely publishable way to report a robustness check. You have just done it.
